decisions.reason: This organic sliced salami platter sits close to the core range and fits the firm's push into organic lines, so the option costs little to keep while demand is still uncertain, though its brief website mention suggests weaker commitment.

The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own page, matches the strategic organic and new-format direction, and is cheap to carry on existing curing capabilities, so the option is worth holding while the result is still open.
The premium sharing salami snack is prominently presented and close to the firm's established offer, so carrying costs are low and it is too early to conclude that its value will not be realized.
